name: R5 exact exterior-channel certificates

on:
  push:
    branches: ['evidence/full-sprint-20261028-r5']
    paths:
      - 'engineering/engineering-followup-20261028-r5/compute/RUN_REQUEST.json'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: r5-exterior-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  exact-certificates:
    if: github.repository == 'TrillionniumFoundation/RAZR-SLIDE' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/evidence/full-sprint-20261028-r5'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 55
    steps:
      - name: Check out this exact evidence source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            engineering/engineering-followup-20261027-r4/envelope
            engineering/engineering-followup-20261028-r5/compute
      - name: Verify reviewed source lock and execute sequential original gates
        env:
          EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD"
          python3 -I -S -B - <<'PY'
          import hashlib
          from pathlib import Path
          p = Path('engineering/engineering-followup-20261028-r5/compute/R5E_PORTABLE_SOURCE_LOCK.json')
          assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == '0c2c867ac8d644341d5d6f0b5596ae2e346061a23cacdab7be6ab18f75eb0a2c'
          PY
          python3 -I -S -B engineering/engineering-followup-20261028-r5/compute/run_portable_exterior_r5e_v3.py \
            --r4-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/engineering/engineering-followup-20261027-r4/envelope" \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/razr-r5-exterior"
      - name: Preserve complete actual outputs including failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
        with:
          name: R5-exterior-channel-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/razr-r5-exterior
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

{
  "schema": "razr-r5-exterior-channel-run-request-v1",
  "prepared_source_commit": "7cf8826f406b8053ed1319096876ce640b9cd8aa",
  "r4_source_commit": "c5f6606924937d716b007cd3ffa8e54df8ecfa5d",
  "source_lock_sha256": "0c2c867ac8d644341d5d6f0b5596ae2e346061a23cacdab7be6ab18f75eb0a2c",
  "sequence": [
    "single_stationary_witness",
    "verify_single",
    "preflight",
    "all_raw",
    "verify_all"
  ],
  "maximum_worker_wall_seconds_each": 600,
  "maximum_worker_RSS_bytes_each": 805306368,
  "maximum_workflow_minutes": 55,
  "scope": "Execute the reviewed conditional exact-real exterior-channel method with original inputs, remaining displacement boxes, clearance threshold and process gates. Preserve every actual failure and unexecuted stage.",
  "native_geometry_execution_requested": false,

}
